basic_details.job_title: DLSA Etah Para-legal Volunteers Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The District Legal Services Authority, Etah (Karyalaya Zila Vidhik Seva Pradhikaran, Etah) has invited applications from interested candidates for Para-legal Volunteers (Paravidhik Swayam Sevak), who will serve the Tehsil Legal Services Committees at Jalesar and Aliganj. Applications are accepted from 23 October 2026 and must be received at the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Etah by 6 November 2026, 5:00 PM; applications received after that are not considered. content_sections.heading: About DLSA Etah Para-legal Volunteers
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Etah is the district-level legal services body in Etah, Uttar Pradesh, chaired by the District Judge. This recruitment of Para-legal Volunteers is being made under letter no. 112/एसएलएसए-90/2023 dated 10.01.2024 of the Uttar Pradesh State Legal Services Authority, on the order of the District Judge / Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Etah. The notice dated 23.10.2026 is signed by Yugal Chandra Chaudhary, Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division) / In-charge Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, Etah.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes to the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Etah. The notice states that only applications received at this office will be valid. Applications will be received from 23 October 2026 until 6 November 2026, 5:00 PM, and applications received after the fixed date will not be considered. The notice prints no fuller postal address, no prescribed application form and no particular mode of delivery (post, courier or by hand). Since receipt at the office is what counts, an application sent by post must reach the office before the deadline. Documents named in the notice: Copy of the Aadhaar card – must be attached with the application. Proof of educational qualification (Matriculation / High School or equivalent), as the notice asks candidates to apply with the records listed under it.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The posts are for Para-legal Volunteers to provide their services in the Tehsil Legal Services Committee, Jalesar and the Tehsil Legal Services Committee, Aliganj. The notice does not mention how many volunteers will be selected. Educational qualification: Matriculation / High School or equivalent. Age limit: not specified in the notice. Pay: No fixed salary is payable to selected Para-legal Volunteers. Only the prescribed honorarium (maandey) will be paid by the State Legal Services Authority, Lucknow. Tenure: Para-legal Volunteers will be selected as per rules for one year. Extension: The tenure may be extended further on the basis of their work efficiency. Candidates should check the official notification for the full wording of the eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says Para-legal Volunteers will be selected as per rules for one year. Selection will be made on a priority basis from the following groups: Retired teachers Persons retired from government service and senior citizens MSW students and teachers Anganwadi workers Doctors Law students Members of NGOs, etc. The notice does not mention a written test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Etah Para-legal Volunteers 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be received at the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Etah by 6 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after that are not considered.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for DLSA Etah Para-legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: Candidates must have Matriculation / High School or equivalent.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of a Para-legal Volunteer in DLSA Etah?
faq.answer: No fixed salary is payable. Only the prescribed honorarium will be paid by the State Legal Services Authority, Lucknow.

faq.question: Q4. How to apply for DLSA Etah Para-legal Volunteers 2026?
faq.answer: Send an application with a copy of the Aadhaar card so that it is received at the Office of the District Legal Services Authority, Etah between 23 October 2026 and 6 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. How are DLSA Etah Para-legal Volunteers selected?
faq.answer: Selection is made as per rules on a priority basis. Priority goes to retired teachers, retired government servants and senior citizens, MSW students and teachers, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students and NGO members.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the selected Para-legal Volunteers work?
faq.answer: They will provide their services in the Tehsil Legal Services Committees at Jalesar and Aliganj in District Etah.

faq.question: Q7. For how long are Para-legal Volunteers engaged by DLSA Etah?
faq.answer: They are selected for one year as per rules. The tenure may be extended on the basis of their work efficiency.

faq.question: Q8. Which document must be attached with the DLSA Etah Para-legal Volunteer application?
faq.answer: A copy of the Aadhaar card must be attached with the application.
